description: Capture a snapshot of TikTok's anonymous For You (FYP) feed. No cookies or login required.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of For You feed posts to collect. Set to 0 to return no items.
maxItems.title: Maximum Items

regionObservation.description: ISO country code to label the observation (e.g. US, GB). This is informational only — TikTok determines the actual region based on server IP.
regionObservation.title: Region (Informational)
